title: Level 3 — 90'er-mall: 12 sektionskoncepter
method: Built-in image_gen.imagegen; one separate generation per image.
status: Concept images only. No Blender geometry or Roblox game changes.

baseline.sourceCheck: Live Configuration, Layout Generator and World Builder unchanged from authoritative audit; Source/editor source equal.

artDirection: Coherent late-1990s shopping mall after closing. Cream/beige and mint service palette, orange party district, burgundy banquet/finale, tactile restrained wear, composed clear routes, no water or characters.
limitations: Concept lighting and shapes are aspirational, not proof of Roblox rendering performance.
Actual room dimensions, portal clearances, collisions, CD/hide anchors and navigation remain to be modeled and tested.
Incidental generated signage is placeholder art.

images.title: Ankomst / information
images.visualReview: Clear warm cream/teal arrival with rounded information kiosk, broad branching circulation, dry terrazzo; coherent mall architecture.

images.title: Beige lounge / food court
images.visualReview: Low-ceilinged lounge, mint banquette planter island and closed food counter; strong open side circulation; matches arrival materials.

images.title: Orange fest- og arkadeområde
images.visualReview: Orange/charcoal arcade-party room, CRT cabinets and jukebox, broad central path and cool mint service transition; dry lowpile carpet.

images.title: Rød banketsal
images.visualReview: Burgundy carpet and cream modular banquet architecture, table groups to sides and a central route, stage/curtain landmark; distinct from orange arcade.

images.title: Servicegang / overgang
images.visualReview: Distinct corner transition, beige/mint service shell, paired service doors and utility equipment; readable clear paths.

images.title: Signal Hall / finale
images.visualReview: Burgundy signal room with CD console and CRTs, long repeated-light finale corridor; desk larger than compact brief, actual implementation clearance not measured.

images.title: Rengøringsdepot
images.visualReview: Compact depot with cleaning trolley, paper shelves, mop rack and floor buffer; clear center and warm light behind brown utility door, no water.

images.title: El-tavlerum
images.visualReview: Analog electrical cabinets, overhead cable trays, rubber runner and aligned doorway; readable grey/mint maintenance room, no sparks.

images.title: Ventilationsrum
images.visualReview: Compact machinery room, galvanized HVAC, mint lower walls, clear dry floor, visible exit; recognizable technical theme.

images.title: Pedelværksted
images.visualReview: Warm workbench with restrained pegboard, darkmint cupboards and large spare motor as landmark; dry but glossier concrete/linoleum floor, visible doorway.

images.title: Skilte- og festlager
images.visualReview: Distinct signage storage with pastel mall panels, chairs, boxes and seasonal props; two visible doorways and clear dry central route.

images.title: PA- og overvågningsrum
images.visualReview: Compact analog CCTV/PA room with CRT monitors and cassette/VHS hardware, warm task lamp against cyan screenlight; incidental fictional posters are conceptual only.
